abstract: We report a case of a 41-year-old man admitted with respiratory distress and found to have masses in both atria of the heart and in the testicle. The patient received palliative radiotherapy to relieving obstruction of blood flow tract caused by the intracardiac masses, followed by radical orchiectomy. After the diagnosis of testicular seminoma, he was treated successfully with 4 cycles of systemic chemotherapy. This is a rare case that presented with metastatic testicular seminoma involving both atria of heart and causing symptomatic obstruction of blood flow tract.
abstract_ja: 41歳の男性が呼吸困難で入院し、両心房内および精巣に腫瘤が認められた。患者は、心内腫瘤による血流路の閉塞を緩和するため緩和的放射線療法を受けた後、根治的精巣摘除術を受けた。精巣セミノーマと診断された後、化学療法4サイクルにより良好に治療された。両心房への転移により血流路の症候性閉塞を来した、まれな転移性精巣セミノーマの症例である。
